name: Human Body
description: Human Body word search puzzles use everyday anatomy English — bone, breath, elbow, artery, muscle and spine — in calm adult language for seniors and grown-up puzzlers. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large-print options. This is vocabulary practice and a quiet pastime, not a medical guide: we make no health claims and list no drug or device brands. No timer and no account. Related reading includes How to Play and our Large Print Pack when eyes need a softer start. For neighboring themes, try Mindfulness, Yoga or Weather when you want other body-in-the-world lists. Open a large-print body puzzle first if standard grids feel tight on a phone.
